name: Korean Rail Celesti Express ITX-MAUM Taebaek Line
description:
Korean Railway Celesti Express ITX-Maeum Taebaek Line is a railway simulation game using real footage of Korea's beautiful railway line.
Players become a train driver and navigate the approximately 283km section from Donghae Station to Cheongnyangni Station, experiencing the allure of a train traveling through the inland region from eastern Korea to Seoul.
This is the first title produced in official collaboration with Korea Railroad Corporation, KORAIL, and providing footage! ________________________________________
Key Features
• Realistic Railway Driving Experience
o Approximately 4 hours of driving course filmed on an actual Taebaek Line train.
o Various route environments, including curves, slopes, tunnels, and bridges, are faithfully captured.
o Supports three play modes: Section Driving Mode, Entire course Driving Mode, and View Mode.
• Control System
o Just like a real train driver, you must delicately operate the train, accelerating and decelerating, stopping, and obeying signals.
o On-time operation and stopping locations are crucial challenges.
o Supports Zuiki's Mascon for Nintendo Switch™ controller.
• Realistic scenery and atmosphere

The game uses footage captured from a camera inside an actual moving train, allowing you to enjoy Korea's inland regions from the comfort of your own train.
________________________________________
Recommended for:
• Gamers interested in railroads and train operation
• Players who want to experience Korea's scenery and travel through a game
• Users who prefer realistic simulations
